name: Manicule
long_description:
Manicule does AgentRel. We get companies discovered and used by AI agents. Think DevRel, rebuilt for a world where agents make all the decisions. We own developer documentation and technical content across social channels, end-to-end. We've grown 100% MoM over the last three months to $53K in monthly revenue, with customers like Supermemory, Greptile, Reducto, and Mastra.
  
Getting discovered and used by agents is its own job now, and the market for it is broken. The SEO/GEO SaaS tools just show you data like where you rank in AI answers. The agencies are slow and lack know-how with agents. The one person who could own all of it end-to-end, a DevRel, is nearly impossible to hire: our customers have had roles open for months at $300K+ and still can't find anyone good. 

We solve all these gaps. Naman has been doing fractional DevRel since he was 13, working with companies like PromptLayer, Brightdata, and Courier.com. Shreyans has been building since 14 — he built an AI app that hit App Store Productivity Trending within a month, and
was the founding engineer at Supermemory. We met in high school and have built multiple startups together since.

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Manicule owns docs and technical content for early-stage devtools across GEO, socials, and product videos. Twice as fast with AI and half the cost of hiring a DevRel, with solid results at Greptile, Skyvern, and Supermemory.

—

[**Manicule**](http://manicule.dev/) is a technical studio that owns your docs and developer-facing content end-to-end to help you grow. We write **for agents** and humans, ship in **<2 weeks**, and have delivered tangible results - **\~37%** less support tickets, millions of impressions on AI search & socials, and **$100K+** in enterprise deals closed across customers.

Customers include [**Greptile**](http://greptile.com/docs) (W24, $25M+ raised), [**Reducto**](http://docs.reducto.ai/) (W24, $100M+ raised), [**Supermemory**](http://supermemory.ai/docs), [Skyvern (S23),](http://skyvern.com/docs) Rootly, etc.

## **The Problem**

* Founders don’t have time to write docs, engineers hate doing it, and it ends up on the backlog forever.
* Nobody knows how to optimize their docs for agents
* AI tools like CC hallucinate code snippets and write empty content without nuance
* Docs sit unused as a growth channel, leaking signups to competitors with better content.

We solve that, and here’s proof.

We’ve engineered agent-optimized docs and benchmarked it on our clients’ docs. On average, agents perform **no errors** while using our approach vs **failing 25% of the time** with other frameworks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/66c15ca0-661e-465a-9356-3af1492a195a)

## **Case Study: Supermemory**

Supermemory had two overlapping products and a lot of internal confusion about what each one was actually for. Customers couldn't figure it out either, and the docs were full of broken code snippets.

So, we:

* Got on calls with their CEO to lock down messaging and figure out the exact outcome each product was best for.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/19709c8a-0654-4eb0-988e-fcd387fe538a)

* Redesigned the information architecture from scratch. We mapped the journey from zero to "aha" and structured the docs like that.
* Wrote every page tied to a concrete developer outcome, with AI agents drafting from the OpenAPI spec and SDK definitions, then humans refining, testing every snippet, and cutting the fluff.

**Results:** 37% increase in answer success rate, multiple enterprise deals closed directly from docs, and viral reception on Twitter.

Here’s the Mintlify stats from **before** our engagement:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/3e448fc8-1672-4d58-bf45-44acd73b0d51)

And from after:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/37eaa68b-ab79-4c37-a41b-784a9fd3f115)

Besides the docs, we also created a lot of blog content, cookbooks, case studies, and videos for GEO, which have bought millions in impressions across AI search and socials.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101237&key=user_uploads/1069030/453c538a-5d5b-4b58-84a2-0c0112c364a2)

## **How we work**

You bring us in for a complete docs write-up that ships in **about 15 days** and **keep us on call 24/7** so your docs never fall behind. From there, we extend across your full developer growth surface like blogs, cookbooks, videos, social distribution, and GEO. All content written for both agents and humans.

## **Our asks**

* **If your docs need work, we'd love to talk.** You can book a call here: [**https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro**](https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro**)
* We’re working with a select few Seed+ companies first for blogs, videos, cookbooks, and overall developer marketing to deliver the best results. If you’d like to be one those, let’s chat: [**https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro**](https://savvycal.com/manicule/intro)
